android.desc:
• The easiest way of getting around is now even easier! Use HOPIN app and order a taxi without dispatch call, buy a parking ticket, order courier service, track public transport vehicles real time, buy bus tickets or see useful timetables. 
•  The most favorite transport app in your city, downloaded by 700 000+ users. 

• TAXI profile
- order a taxi with a simple tap without calling 
- pay by credit card or cash
- see estimate price for your ride
- choose a taxi by your preferences - car list, quiet ride
- ride with professional drivers
- if necessary, it is possible to communicate with the driver via the application or the phone
- ECONOMY ride - take a ride with us anywhere and anytime - quickly, safely and for better prices
- PREMIUM ride - we chose for you higher class vehicles for more comfy ride and drivers with the best ratings
- EKO ride - choose electric and hybrid cars for your ride

• PARKING service
- buy a parking ticket through HOPIN app in Bratislava
- synchronize your Bratislava Parking Assistant (PAAS) account and parking card
- quick and easy electronic online parking reservation
- create your profile and add car ID (EČV) 

• BUS profile
- easiest way to buy e-ticket for your bus
- find the best routes for public transport
- see real-time public transport directions
- nearby lines and stations
- complete map of all stops with timetables

• COURIER service
- click on the courier icon, enter the pick-up and delivery address of the package and we will take care of the rest
- online service that is available 24/7
- express shipments or at a specific time
- after entering the addresses, you will know the price for delivery in advance

• You can order taxi with HOPIN app in Bratislava, Košice, Martin, Prievidza, Poprad, Michalovce, Humenné and Prague, Ostrava, Kyiv, Chernihiv, Ljubljana and soon in other cities.
• Courier service and Bus profile are available only in Slovakia.
• All important information you can find on www.hopintaxi.com

quotes.text:
Apps like these existed before[1], many real and licensed taxi drivers participated. Only difference I can think of is that the driver decided the price (as he had to), app was there to just check it for users. You could pay both through the app and in person I believe.

1. https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=sk.hopin.taxiapp
quotes.story_title: French Uber drivers have created their own Uber
